task_and_failure: Native same-thread tool-turn interruption and resume had not been qualified by process restart or ordinary worktree tests.
discovery_provenance: Named native-session recovery gap in the accepted engineering architecture.
license_and_compatibility: Original MIT fixture; standard-library harness using experimental native app-server dynamic tools on the installed bundled Mac alpha. Official-source revision is a fetched documentation-section digest, not an upstream release.

baseline_and_candidate.baseline: Unqualified same-session recovery; no model baseline executed
baseline_and_candidate.candidate: One checkpoint, interrupted pending tool, second native process resuming identical thread/session, finalization without replay

predeclared_metrics.quality_rule: Every frozen fixture.assess gate is true; verify independently against retained native protocol and exact checkpoint/final bytes.
predeclared_metrics.usage_rule: Final native cumulative snapshot once; cache read remains an input subset; missing retries, costs and enclosing coordinator usage remain unknown; no savings claim.

runtime_and_platform.isolation: Owned synthetic Git fixture and two sequential app-server processes; inherited native account/configuration and integrations.

observations.scope: One owned synthetic dynamic-tool checkpoint, native turn interruption, new app-server process and same-thread resume on one Mac

limitations: One synthetic attempt and two native turns; no matched baseline or savings claim.
Dynamic tool service is owned by this harness; no arbitrary shell, remote provider cancellation, network outage, host power-loss or independent-host restore was tested.
The coordinator sends a concise continuation after resume; it does not replay messages or create a replacement native thread.
The unchanged checkpoint and exact action sequence establish one observed effect, not an exactly-once distributed-system guarantee.
Existing native authentication, configuration, caches and persisted session stores are used; worktree isolation is not account or service isolation.
Full native protocol, identifiers and paths remain private. Hashes identify retained logs, not independent provider attestation.
Current runner minimizes configuration logs after review; the original executed source is separately retained and no new model trial was run for that logging change.

decision_and_scope.scope: One owned synthetic dynamic-tool checkpoint, native turn interruption, new app-server process and same-thread resume on one Mac

rollback: Stop only owned app-server processes; keep existing configuration and native session history. Preserve private evidence and disposable fixture.
next_decision_changing_test: A separately frozen Claude-native session recovery check or independent-host restore; neither is implied by this Mac result.
